CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS client_onboarding_receipts (
 user_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES users(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
 request_key VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL,
 status VARCHAR(16) NOT NULL,
 request_hash VARCHAR(64),
 result JSONB,
 change_log_id INTEGER REFERENCES change_logs(id) ON DELETE SET NULL,
 PRIMARY KEY (user_id, request_key),
 CONSTRAINT ck_client_onboarding_receipts_terminal CHECK (
 (status = 'cancelled' AND request_hash IS NULL AND result IS NULL AND change_log_id IS NULL) OR
 (status = 'confirmed' AND request_hash IS NOT NULL AND request_hash ~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$' AND result IS NOT NULL AND jsonb_typeof(result) = 'object')),
 CONSTRAINT ck_client_onboarding_receipts_key CHECK (request_key ~ '^[A-Za-z0-9_-]{16,64}$')
)
